fields.name: Dairy Farm Quarry
fields.description: A disused granite quarry turned bouldering and sport-climbing playground on the fringes of Bukit Timah. Big slabs, cracks and overhangs make it the spiritual home of Singapore outdoor climbing.
fields.hazards: Access to the rock walls is currently prohibited by NParks due to rockfall risk. Use this listing for route-reference only; do not enter restricted areas.

fields.name: Bukit Timah Nature Reserve
fields.description: Singapore's highest point hides granite boulders scattered along the Hindu end and the old quarry trails. A classic urban-crag session with shade and easy access.
fields.hazards: Mosquitoes at dusk; stay on marked trails. Some landings are uneven.

fields.name: Mandai Rock
fields.description: Quiet granite outcrops near the zoo. A handful of tall sport lines and quality boulder problems for a peaceful session away from the crowds.
fields.hazards: Limited shade; bring water. Access paths can be overgrown.

fields.name: Pulau Ubin Granite
fields.description: Take a bumboat to the island for rustic granite bouldering among the old granite quarries. A half-day adventure with a true get-away vibe.
fields.hazards: Ferry closes in the evening — plan your return. Watch for monkeys.

fields.name: The Cliff @ Snow City
fields.description: Singapore's first indoor climbing wall, located inside Snow City. Floor-to-ceiling artificial walls with top-rope, lead and a boulder cave.
fields.hazards: Indoor — no environmental hazards. Pre-book weekends.

fields.name: Onsight Climbing Gym
fields.description: A large, well-lit bouldering and lead gym in the east with regularly reset problems and beginner classes.
fields.hazards: Indoor — padded flooring. Warm-up before hard attempts.

fields.name: Boulder+ (The Chevrons)
fields.description: Premium bouldering-only facility with angles, slabs and a training area. Friendly community and weekly competitions.
fields.hazards: Indoor — no external hazards. Grades can feel stiff!

fields.name: Climb Central
fields.description: Central, high-ceiling lead and boulder gym with a café. Great for after-work sessions and first-timers.
fields.hazards: Indoor — slip mats in place. Peak hours get busy.

fields.name: Kinetics Climbing
fields.description: East-side bouldering gym with a strong training culture, campus boards and frequent resets.
fields.hazards: Indoor — fingerboard area, pace your sessions.

fields.name: The Milky Way
fields.description: Sustained slab to a small roof.

fields.name: Zoo View
fields.description: Long line with a committing crux.
